data.name: Omnificent
data.detailed_description:
Step into Omnificent, the ultimate spell-casting, first-person action-roguelite that puts the power of magic in your hands. Customize your playstyle by crafting unique combinations of spells, equipment, and characters as you explore diverse landscapes, battle dynamic enemies, and face strategic challenges. Whether you’re launching elemental blasts or summoning stone turrets, each run offers fresh opportunities to create devastating synergies.

Key Features:
• 10 Unique Characters: Master a variety of playstyles with characters that each have their own magical abilities and tactical options.
• 30+ Spells: From explosive elemental magic to earth-forged turrets, mix and match spells to discover powerful combos that keep your enemies guessing.
• 30+ Pieces of Equipment: Enhance your gameplay with equipment that modifies your spells and abilities, offering new strategies and builds each time.
• Diverse Enemies: Engage in fast-paced combat against foes with unique attack patterns, ensuring each encounter is different.
• Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: A welcoming experience for new players with layers of depth for veterans seeking a challenge.
• Varied Landscapes: Each themed level introduces unique challenges and opportunities, keeping every run immersive and unpredictable.
• Level Events and Rewards: Discover hidden events that reward clever puzzle solving and ferocious fighting with powerful rewards.
• Synergistic Build-Crafting: Combine characters, spells, and gear for infinite build possibilities. Each element complements the others for deep strategic play.
• Permanent Progression: Unlock meaningful upgrades that carry over between runs, enhancing your abilities and creating a rewarding sense of progression.

For fans of action-packed combat, strategic build-crafting, and magical mastery, Omnificent offers a thrilling journey where every decision matters. Will you triumph with your perfect build, or will chaos reign?
